From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchid Health — Implementation sprint & CS kickoff

Team / Sara & Tim,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get Orchid live. Quick handoff summary so CS and CloudOps have context before we lock a kickoff date. Attaching the draft SOW and MAP (see attachments).

Deal highlights (TL;DR):
- Product: real-time triage assistant (chat + embeddings) in caregiver workflow.
- SLA target: 99.9% inference availability, 200ms p50 latency goal for short prompts.
- Initial scope: Sandbox -> Staging -> Prod over 6 weeks; first milestone is sandbox provisioning and SSO test.
- Data residency: US-only; logs retained 90 days.
- Contract: committed Reserved pool (Dedicated) + hosted fallback for spikes.

Success criteria (from customer):
1) End-to-end response time under 250ms for 75% of flows;
2) SSO + SCIM integration complete;
3) Team comfortable with rollout & fallback policy.

Immediate asks for CS / CloudOps:
- Please confirm implementation lead (owner) and proposed kickoff window next week.
- Marissa: please review the MAP and call out any missing pre-kick checklist items.
- Hannah: we will need a sandbox GPU pool (2x T4 equivalent) and a short-lived API key for test automation.

Attachments: Orchid_Statement_of_Work_v1.pdf, Orchid_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

I'll be on the kickoff and will hand over day-to-day ownership to the CS lead. Karthik — pinging you to escalate to the right CS owner.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Assigning Marissa as Implementation Lead (she'll be primary CS owner). Marissa, welcome — please confirm a kickoff date; our preference is week of 6/14 to give Hannah a little runway for sandbox prep.

Initial CS plan (short list):
- Week 0: Provision sandbox, exchange SSO certs/test users, provision Test API key.
- Week 1: Integration smoke tests (chat flows + embeddings), baseline latency testing.
- Week 2–3: Staging rollout, production runbook pairing.

Marissa — please own the MAP and produce a 1-page Sprint Plan with owners for the sandbox milestone by Monday. Hannah, can you confirm estimated ETA for a test GPU pool and whether we should request a dedicated shape or use shared burst?

I'll join the kickoff to cover rollout policy and escalation paths.

Thanks all — happy to take point. Quick notes from my side and a proposed pre-kick checklist.

Proposed kickoff: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:00am PT (45–60 min) — covers introductions, scope, timeline, and immediate blockers. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Marissa's pre-kick checklist (items I will own / request):
- Customer POC(s) for integration: need email for SSO admin + one developer for API keys (Sara/Tim — please confirm).
- Sandbox environment: Hannah to provision a 2-node T4 pool (non-prod), ephemeral API key for automation tests, and a shared test account.
- SSO/SCIM: Exchange IdP metadata and test user. Document expected attributes map (email, role, org).
- Data retention & logging: confirm log retention window (customer requested 90 days) and where audit logs will be stored.
- Rollout policy: confirm canary % & fallback model (we suggested hosted fallback).

Attachments: Onboarding_Checklist.csv (initial), I also left comments in the MAP (Orchid_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx).

Hannah — can you confirm the sandbox ETA (days) and whether we need a ticket to infra to spin up the dedicated test shape? If so I'll create a ticket and assign to CloudOps.

Sara / Tim — can you share the SSO admin contact and whether Orchid prefers Okta or Azure AD? Also please confirm preferred kickoff time slot.

Thanks — I'll draft the 1-page Sprint Plan and share by Monday EOD.

-Marissa Cole
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
